newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-YOUTH INJURED AS BOTTLE EXPLODES AT TEST MATCH. [CORRECTED 23:04 GMT]
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-YOUTH INJURED AS BOTTLE EXPLODES AT TEST MATCH. [CORRECTED 23:04 GMT]

text.p: (Corrects headline and the text to youth instead of a young boy.)
A youth was injured when a plastic bottle exploded in his hand as he went to pick it up during the third cricket test between South Africa and Australia on Sunday.
Play in the final session was halted for five minutes as paramedics rushed to assist Peter Nel, 18 (corrects from "thought to be aged about 10"), who was taken to a hospital.
Ground officials said two other boys had allegedly been seen inserting dry ice into the bottle before shaking it to "prime" it to explode.
